panels.title: ◈ Machine Context

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: full dataset scope */
SELECT eqp_id AS "Machine", state AS "State", mo AS "MO", fpn AS "FPN", layer_name AS "Layer", (board_no::TEXT || '/' || total_board::TEXT) AS "Board", filmno AS "Film", resist AS "Resist", scale_mode AS "Scale Mode", "time" AS "Timestamp" FROM public.ldi_data WHERE log_id = (COALESCE(
  (
    SELECT d0.log_id
    FROM public.ldi_data d0
    WHERE ${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC > 0
      AND d0.eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
    ORDER BY ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (d0."time" - to_timestamp(${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC / 1000.0)))), d0."time" DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  NULLIF(${log_id:sqlstring}, '__auto__')
)) LIMIT 1

panels.title: ◈ Position Error (PE1-PE6) + MAX|PE|

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: full dataset scope */
SELECT ROUND(pe_1::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_1",ROUND(pe_2::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_2",
 ROUND(pe_3::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_3",ROUND(pe_4::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_4",
 ROUND(pe_5::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_5",ROUND(pe_6::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_6",
 ROUND(max_pe::NUMERIC,3) AS "MAX|PE|",ROUND(pe_setting::NUMERIC,3) AS "pe_setting",
 CASE WHEN max_pe IS NULL THEN 'N/A' WHEN max_pe <= pe_setting THEN 'PASS' ELSE 'OUT OF SPEC' END AS "PE Status"
FROM (
 SELECT d.*,GREATEST(ABS(pe_1),ABS(pe_2),ABS(pe_3),ABS(pe_4),ABS(pe_5),ABS(pe_6)) AS max_pe
 FROM public.ldi_data d WHERE log_id=(COALESCE(
  (
    SELECT d0.log_id
    FROM public.ldi_data d0
    WHERE ${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC > 0
      AND d0.eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
    ORDER BY ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (d0."time" - to_timestamp(${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC / 1000.0)))), d0."time" DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  NULLIF(${log_id:sqlstring}, '__auto__')
)) LIMIT 1
) event_row;

panels.description: Real PE values from the selected event. N/A means this machine/event did not provide PE data.

panels.title: ◈ Process Capability (PE & JE) — Worst Cpk
panels.description: Combined PE + JE process capability for the selected machine(s)/event. Worst Cpk = LEAST(Cpk PE, Cpk JE); Confidence flags LOW SAMPLE when the deciding sample count is below 30, NO_DATA when neither PE nor JE produced samples.

targets.rawSql:
WITH selected_machines AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT eqp_id FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE ((${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC > 0 AND eqp_id=split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring},' - ',1))
    OR (${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC <= 0 AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})))
), pe_samples AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id,d.pe_setting,p.pe FROM public.ldi_data d JOIN selected_machines sm ON sm.eqp_id=d.eqp_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES(d.pe_1),(d.pe_2),(d.pe_3),(d.pe_4),(d.pe_5),(d.pe_6)) p(pe)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time") AND p.pe IS NOT NULL AND d.pe_setting IS NOT NULL
), pe_stats AS (
  SELECT eqp_id,COUNT(*) n_pe,AVG(pe) mean_pe,STDDEV_SAMP(pe) stddev_pe,AVG(pe_setting) pe_lim FROM pe_samples GROUP BY eqp_id
), pe_capability AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, n_pe,
    pe_lim/NULLIF(3*stddev_pe,0) AS cp_pe,
    LEAST((pe_lim-mean_pe)/NULLIF(3*stddev_pe,0),(mean_pe+pe_lim)/NULLIF(3*stddev_pe,0)) AS cpk_pe
  FROM pe_stats
), je_samples AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id,d.je_setting,j.je FROM public.ldi_data d JOIN selected_machines sm ON sm.eqp_id=d.eqp_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES(d.je_1),(d.je_2),(d.je_3),(d.je_4)) j(je)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time") AND j.je IS NOT NULL AND d.je_setting IS NOT NULL
), je_stats AS (
  SELECT eqp_id,COUNT(*) n_je,AVG(je) mean_je,STDDEV_SAMP(je) stddev_je,AVG(je_setting) je_lim FROM je_samples GROUP BY eqp_id
), je_capability AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, n_je,
    je_lim/NULLIF(3*stddev_je,0) AS cp_je,
    LEAST((je_lim-mean_je)/NULLIF(3*stddev_je,0),(mean_je+je_lim)/NULLIF(3*stddev_je,0)) AS cpk_je
  FROM je_stats
), combined AS (
  SELECT sm.eqp_id, p.n_pe, p.cpk_pe, j.n_je, j.cpk_je
  FROM selected_machines sm
  LEFT JOIN pe_capability p ON p.eqp_id=sm.eqp_id
  LEFT JOIN je_capability j ON j.eqp_id=sm.eqp_id
), worst AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE WHEN cpk_pe IS NULL THEN cpk_je WHEN cpk_je IS NULL THEN cpk_pe ELSE LEAST(cpk_pe,cpk_je) END AS worst_cpk,
    CASE WHEN cpk_pe IS NULL THEN n_je WHEN cpk_je IS NULL THEN n_pe WHEN cpk_pe<=cpk_je THEN n_pe ELSE n_je END AS worst_n
  FROM combined
)
SELECT eqp_id AS "Machine",
  n_pe AS "PE Samples", ROUND(cpk_pe::NUMERIC,2) AS "Cpk (PE)",
  n_je AS "JE Samples", ROUND(cpk_je::NUMERIC,2) AS "Cpk (JE)",
  ROUND(worst_cpk::NUMERIC,2) AS "Worst Cpk",
  worst_n AS "N (Worst)",
  CASE WHEN worst_cpk IS NULL THEN 'NO_DATA' WHEN COALESCE(worst_n,0)<30 THEN 'LOW SAMPLE (n<30)' ELSE 'OK' END AS "Confidence"
FROM worst
ORDER BY worst_cpk ASC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1000;

panels.title: ◈ Alarm Context (±5 min of clicked timestamp)

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: full dataset scope */
WITH target AS (SELECT "time" FROM public.ldi_data WHERE log_id=(COALESCE(
  (
    SELECT d0.log_id
    FROM public.ldi_data d0
    WHERE ${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC > 0
      AND d0.eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
    ORDER BY ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (d0."time" - to_timestamp(${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC / 1000.0)))), d0."time" DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  NULLIF(${log_id:sqlstring}, '__auto__')
)) LIMIT 1),
selected_machine AS (
 SELECT DISTINCT eqp_id FROM public.ldi_data
 WHERE (${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC > 0 AND eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring},' - ',1))
    OR (COALESCE(${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC, 0) <= 0 AND eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring}))
), alarm_rows AS (
SELECT al.logdate AS "Time",al.equipmentid AS "Machine",al.errorcode::TEXT AS "errorcode",al.errortime::TEXT AS "errortime",
 COALESCE(m.alarm_msg,al.errorcode::TEXT) AS "Message",COALESCE(m.severity,'UNMAPPED') AS "Severity"
FROM public.ldi_alarm_log al CROSS JOIN selected_machine sm
LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON al.errorcode::TEXT=m.alarm_code::TEXT
WHERE al.equipmentid=sm.eqp_id
 AND al.logdate BETWEEN (SELECT "time"-INTERVAL '5 minutes' FROM target) AND (SELECT "time"+INTERVAL '5 minutes' FROM target)
)
SELECT "Time", "Machine", "errorcode", "errortime", "Message", "Severity" FROM alarm_rows
UNION ALL
SELECT target."time",sm.eqp_id,NULL::TEXT,NULL::TEXT,'No alarm in +/-5 minutes (real data)','NONE'
FROM target CROSS JOIN selected_machine sm WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alarm_rows)
ORDER BY "Time" DESC;

panels.description: Real alarms within +/-5 minutes of the selected ldi_data.log_id event. No data is valid when alarm and telemetry exports do not overlap.

panels.title: ◈ Event Timeline around Selected Log ID (+/-5 min)

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: bounded lookup around a single log_id, +/-5min window per machine */
WITH target AS (
  SELECT "time" AS t
  FROM public.ldi_data
  WHERE log_id = (COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT d0.log_id
      FROM public.ldi_data d0
      WHERE ${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC > 0
        AND d0.eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1)
      ORDER BY ABS(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (d0."time" - to_timestamp(${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC / 1000.0)))), d0."time" DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ),
    NULLIF(${log_id:sqlstring}, '__auto__')
  ))
  LIMIT 1
),
state_rows AS (
  SELECT d."time" AS event_time,
         d.eqp_id,
         d.state,
         LAG(d.state) OVER (PARTITION BY d.eqp_id ORDER BY d."time") AS prev_state
  FROM public.ldi_data d, target
  WHERE ((${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC > 0 AND d.eqp_id = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1))
      OR (${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC <= 0 AND d.eqp_id IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})))
    AND d."time" BETWEEN target.t - INTERVAL '20 minutes' AND target.t + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
),
events AS (
  SELECT event_time, eqp_id,
         CASE WHEN state THEN 'START' ELSE 'STOP' END AS event_type,
         'ldi_data'::TEXT AS source,
         CASE WHEN state THEN 'Machine started (RUNNING)' ELSE 'Machine stopped (DOWN)' END AS description,
         NULL::TEXT AS severity
  FROM state_rows, target
  WHERE prev_state IS NOT NULL AND state IS DISTINCT FROM prev_state
    AND event_time BETWEEN target.t - INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND target.t + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT a.logdate, a.equipmentid, 'ALARM', 'ldi_alarm_log',
         COALESCE(m.alarm_msg, a.errorcode::TEXT),
         m.severity
  FROM public.ldi_alarm_log a
  LEFT JOIN public.ldi_alarm_ms_code m ON a.errorcode::TEXT = m.alarm_code::TEXT, target
  WHERE ((${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC > 0 AND a.equipmentid = split_part(${clicked_series:sqlstring}, ' - ', 1))
      OR (${event_time_ms:sqlstring}::NUMERIC <= 0 AND a.equipmentid IN (${machine_id:sqlstring})))
    AND a.logdate BETWEEN target.t - INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND target.t + INTERVAL '5 minutes'
)
SELECT event_time AS "Event Time", eqp_id AS "Machine", event_type AS "Event Type", source AS "Source", description AS "Description", severity AS "Severity"
FROM events
ORDER BY event_time DESC
LIMIT 100;

panels.description: Event Time / Machine / Event Type / Source / Description / Severity around the selected log_id. State rows are LAG-deduplicated to real START/STOP transitions only (raw ldi_data polls every 6-60s, so without dedup the +/-5min window fills with duplicate RUNNING rows and can push real alarms past the LIMIT 100 cap).

FROM (
 SELECT d.*,GREATEST(ABS(je_1),ABS(je_2),ABS(je_3),ABS(je_4)) AS max_je
